en.t: Gothic War: The Byzantine general Belisarius enters Rome unopposed; the Gothic garrison flees the capital
en.s: The Gothic War between the Byzantine Empire during the reign of Emperor Justinian I and the Ostrogoths (Goths) took place from 535 to 554 in the Italian Peninsula, Dalmatia, Sardinia, Sicily, and Corsica. It was the last of the Gothic wars against the Byzantine Empire. The war had its roots in Justinian's ambition to recover the provinces of the former Western Roman Empire, which had been lost to invading barbarian tribes during the Migration Period.

zh.t: 哥特战争：拜占庭将军贝利撒留不战而入罗马，哥特守军逃离首都
zh.s: 哥特战争发生于535年至554年，是查士丁尼一世统治时期的拜占庭帝国与东哥特人之间的战争，战场遍及意大利半岛、达尔马提亚、撒丁岛、西西里岛和科西嘉岛。这是东哥特人与拜占庭帝国之间最后一场哥特战争。战争源于查士丁尼一世试图收复前西罗马帝国的行省；这些行省在民族大迁徙时期被入侵的部族夺取。

en.s: The Battle of Marj Ardabil was a military engagement between the Umayyads and the Khazars in AD 730. A Khazar army led by Barjik, the Khazar Khagan, inflicted a catastrophic defeat on the Umayyads, killing the majority of the army and its leader, al-Jarrah ibn Abdallah. Afterwards, the Khazars sacked Azerbaijan freely at will.
en.n: Battle of Marj Ardabil: The Khazars annihilate an Umayyad army and kill its commander, al-Jarrah ibn Abdallah al-Hakami.

zh.t: 马尔吉·阿尔达比勒战役
zh.s: 马尔吉·阿尔达比勒战役是公元730年倭马亚王朝与可萨人之间的一场军事冲突。可萨可汗巴尔吉克率军重创倭马亚军队，杀死大部分士兵及其统帅贾拉赫·伊本·阿卜杜拉。此后，可萨人长驱直入，洗劫阿塞拜疆。
zh.n: 马尔吉·阿尔达比勒战役：可萨人全歼倭马亚军队，并杀死其统帅贾拉赫·伊本·阿卜杜拉·哈卡米。

en.t: On December 9, 1425, Martin founded the University of Louvain or Universitas Lovaniensis in Leuven (also known as "Louvain" in both English and French), a town in what was then the Duchy of Brabant, and what is modern day Belgium
en.s: Pope Martin V (Latin: Martinus V; Italian: Martino V; January/February 1369 – 20 February 1431), born Oddone Colonna, was the head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 11 November 1417 to his death in February 1431. His election effectively ended the Western Schism of 1378–1417. As of 2026, he remains the last pope to have taken the pontifical name "Martin".

zh.t: 教宗马丁五世于1425年12月9日在鲁汶创办鲁汶大学（Universitas Lovaniensis）
zh.s: 教宗马丁五世（拉丁语：Martinus V；意大利语：Martino V；1369年1月或2月—1431年2月20日），本名奥多内·科隆纳，1417年11月11日至1431年2月去世期间担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者。他的当选实际上结束了1378年至1417年的西方教会大分裂。截至2026年，他仍是最后一位取教宗名为“马丁”的教宗。

en.t: The first battle between the forces of Švitrigaila and Sigismund Kęstutaitis is fought near the town of Oszmiana (Ashmyany), launching the most active phase of the Lithuanian Civil War
en.s: Sigismund Kęstutaitis (Lithuanian: Žygimantas I Kęstutaitis, Polish: Zygmunt Kiejstutowicz; c. 1365 – 20 March 1440) was Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1432 to 1440. Sigismund was his baptismal name, while his pagan Lithuanian birth name is unknown. He was the son of Grand Duke Kęstutis and his wife Birutė. After the death of Kęstutis, he was a prisoner of Jogaila from 1382 to 1384.

zh.t: 斯维特里盖拉与齐吉曼特·克斯图泰蒂斯的军队在奥什米亚尼亚（今阿什梅尼）镇附近首次交战，立陶宛内战由此进入最激烈阶段

The invasion was preceded by the Later Jin invasion of Joseon in 1627.

en.s: The Bornholm uprising (Danish: Den bornholmske opstand, Swedish: Upproret på Bornholm), also known as the Bornholm revolt, was a popular uprising against the newly established Swedish presence on the island of Bornholm. After the decisive Dano-Swedish War of 1657–1658, Skåneland, including Bornholm, was ceded to the Swedish Empire in the Treaty of Roskilde. However, increased taxes and conscription by the new Swedish governor, Johan Printzensköld, led to major discontent with the local inhabitants.

zh.s: 博恩霍尔姆起义也称博恩霍尔姆反抗，是岛上居民反对瑞典新政权统治的一场民众起义。1657—1658年丹麦与瑞典交战后，包括博恩霍尔姆岛在内的斯科讷地区根据《罗斯基勒条约》割让给瑞典帝国。新任瑞典总督约翰·普林岑斯科尔德加征税赋并强征兵员，引发当地居民强烈不满。

en.s: See also Battle of Reading (871), Siege of Reading (1642–1643) The Battle of Reading took place on 9 December 1688 in Reading, Berkshire. It was the only substantial military action in England during the Glorious Revolution and ended in a decisive victory for forces loyal to William of Orange. It was celebrated in Reading for hundreds of years afterwards.

zh.s: 雷丁战役于1688年12月9日在伯克郡雷丁爆发，是光荣革命期间英格兰境内唯一一场规模较大的军事行动。效忠奥兰治的威廉的军队取得决定性胜利。此后数百年间，雷丁当地一直纪念这场战役。

A British Army rearguard led by James Stanhope, 1st Earl Stanhope was cut off and trapped within the town of Brihuega before being overwhelmed by a Franco-Spanish army under the command of Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme.

zh.s: 第七次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争也称第二次摩里亚战争、小战争，在克罗地亚又称辛吉战争，交战双方为威尼斯共和国和奥斯曼帝国，战争于1714年至1718年间进行。这是两国之间最后一场战争，以奥斯曼帝国获胜、威尼斯失去在希腊半岛上的主要领地伯罗奔尼撒半岛（摩里亚）告终。

en.s: The siege of Pizzighettone was the first major military engagement of the northern Italian campaigns of the War of the Polish Succession. Troops from France and the Kingdom of Sardinia began blockading the Habsburg Milanese fortress at Pizzighettone on 11 November 1733, commencing siege operations on 15 November. On 30 November the commander of the Austrian garrison negotiated a capitulation in which he promised to withdraw toward Mantua on 9 December if no relief arrived.

en.s: The invasion of Cuba took place between 4–5 August and 9 December 1741 during the War of Jenkins' Ear. A combined army and naval force under the command of Admiral Edward Vernon and Major-General Thomas Wentworth arrived off Cuba and fortified positions around their landing site at Cumberland Bay. Despite facing no serious opposition, neither commander felt prepared to advance on the Spanish settlement at Santiago de Cuba.

zh.s: 詹金斯耳朵战争期间，英军于1741年8月4日至5日和12月9日两次进攻古巴。爱德华·弗农海军上将和托马斯·温特沃思少将率领陆海军联合部队抵达古巴附近，并在坎伯兰湾的登陆点周围构筑防御阵地。尽管没有遇到有力抵抗，两位指挥官都觉得尚未准备好继续进攻西班牙人控制的圣地亚哥-德古巴。

en.s: The Battle of Condore took place near Masulipatam on 9 December 1758 during the Third Carnatic War, part of the Seven Years' War. An Anglo-Indian force under the command of Colonel Francis Forde attacked and defeated a similarly sized French force under the command of Hubert de Brienne, Comte de Conflans, capturing all their baggage and artillery.

zh.s: 康多尔战役于1758年12月9日在马苏利帕特南附近爆发，属于第三次卡纳提克战争（七年战争的一部分）。弗朗西斯·福德上校率领一支英印联军进攻由康夫朗伯爵于贝尔·德·布里埃纳指挥的一支规模相近的法军，并将其击败；法军的全部辎重和火炮都被缴获。

en.s: The siege of Melilla was an attempt by the Sultanate of Morocco, supported by Algerian mercenaries, to capture the Spanish fortress of Melilla on the Moroccan Mediterranean coast. Mohammed ben Abdallah, then Sultan of Morocco, invaded Melilla in December 1774 with a large army of Royal Moroccan soldiers and Algerian mercenaries. The city was defended by a small garrison under Irish-born Governor Don Juan Sherlocke until the siege was lifted by a relief fleet in March 1775.

zh.s: 摩洛哥苏丹国在阿尔及利亚雇佣兵的协助下，试图攻占位于摩洛哥地中海沿岸的西班牙要塞梅利利亚。时任摩洛哥苏丹穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉于1774年12月率领大批摩洛哥王家军和阿尔及利亚雇佣兵入侵梅利利亚。爱尔兰裔总督唐·胡安·舍洛克率领一支小型守军驻守该城，直到1775年3月援军舰队抵达，围城才告解除。

en.s: The Battle of Great Bridge was fought December 9, 1775, in the area of Great Bridge, Virginia, early in the American Revolutionary War. The victory by Continental Army and militia forces led to the departure of Governor Lord Dunmore and any remaining vestiges of British power from the Colony of Virginia during the early days of the conflict. Following increasing political and military tensions in early 1775, both Dunmore and rebellious Whig leaders recruited troops and engaged in a struggle for available military supplies. The struggle eventually focused on Norfolk, where Dunmore had taken refuge aboard a Royal Navy vessel.

zh.s: 大桥战役于1775年12月9日在弗吉尼亚州大桥一带爆发，是美国独立战争初期的一场战斗。大陆军和民兵获胜后，邓莫尔勋爵总督离开弗吉尼亚殖民地，英国势力也随之撤出。1775年初政治和军事局势日益紧张，邓莫尔和反叛的辉格党领袖都开始招募军队，争夺军需物资。双方的冲突最终集中在诺福克；邓莫尔当时已躲到一艘英国皇家海军舰艇上。

en.s: The Battle of Ayacucho (Spanish: Batalla de Ayacucho, IPA: [baˈtaʎa ðe aʝaˈkutʃo]) was a decisive military encounter during the Peruvian War of Independence. It was the battle that secured the independence of Peru and ensured independence for the rest of South America. In Peru it is considered the end of the Spanish American wars of independence, although the campaign of the victor Antonio José de Sucre, continued through 1825 in Upper Peru and the siege of the fortresses Chiloé and Callao finally ended in 1826. As of late 1824, Royalists still had control of most of the south of Peru as well as of Real Felipe Fort in the port of Callao.

zh.s: 阿亚库乔战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Ayacucho）是秘鲁独立战争中的一场决定性战斗，巩固了秘鲁独立，也确保南美其他地区走向独立。秘鲁通常将此战视为西属美洲独立战争的终点，不过胜方安东尼奥·何塞·德·苏克雷的军事行动仍持续到1825年上秘鲁战役结束；奇洛埃岛和卡亚俄要塞的围城战则到1826年才结束。1824年末，保王派仍控制着秘鲁南部大部分地区，以及卡亚俄港的皇家费利佩要塞。

en.s: The Battle of Chusto-Talasah (also known as Bird Creek, Caving Banks, and High Shoal) was fought December 9, 1861, in what is now Tulsa County, Oklahoma (then Indian Territory) during the American Civil War. en.s: The Attack on Nibeiwa took place on 9 December 1940 near Nibeiwa, Egypt, when the Italian fortified camp held by the Maletti Group, the armoured force of the 10th Army, was overrun by British and Indian troops. The attack was the opening engagement of Operation Compass, a British raid which, if successful, would be followed up to try to expel the Italians from Egypt.

zh.s: 1940年12月9日，尼贝瓦战役在埃及尼贝瓦附近爆发。英印联军攻陷了意大利第10集团军的装甲部队马莱蒂集团驻守的防御营地。这是英国“指南针行动”突袭的首场战斗；如果行动成功，英军将继续进攻，试图把意大利军队逐出埃及。

en.s: Operation Compass (also Italian: Battaglia della Marmarica) was the first large British military operation of the Western Desert Campaign (1940–1943) during the Second World War. British metropolitan, Imperial and Commonwealth forces attacked the Italian and Libyan forces of the 10th Army (Marshal Rodolfo Graziani) in western Egypt and Cyrenaica, the eastern province of Libya, from December 1940 to February 1941.
en.n: World War II: Operation Compass: British and Indian troops under the command of Major-General Richard O'Connor attack Italian forces near Sidi Barrani in Egypt.

zh.s: 指南针行动（意大利语：Battaglia della Marmarica）是第二次世界大战期间英国在西部沙漠战役（1940—1943年）中发起的首场大型军事行动。1940年12月至1941年2月，英国本土、帝国及英联邦部队进攻鲁道夫·格拉齐亚尼陆军元帅指挥的意大利和利比亚第10集团军。该军驻扎在埃及西部及利比亚东部的昔兰尼加。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：指南针行动：理查德·奥康纳少将指挥英军和印度军队，在埃及西迪巴拉尼附近进攻意大利军队。

en.s: The 1946 Hamilton municipal election was held on December 9, 1946, to select one mayor, four controllers, and sixteen members of the Hamilton, Ontario City Council, as well as members of the local board of education. zh.s: 汉密尔顿于1946年12月9日举行市政选举，选出1名市长、4名市政监察员、16名市议员以及地方教育委员会成员。选举紧接1946年斯特尔科钢铁厂罢工举行，投票率创下纪录，65.1%的合资格选民投了票。

en.t: India's Constituent Assembly meets for the first time
en.s: On December 9, 1946, India's Constituent Assembly held its first meeting in Constitution Hall in New Delhi. The sitting began at 11 a.m., and Sachchidananda Sinha took the chair temporarily. This was the opening session of the body that later drafted India's constitution; the constitution itself was adopted in 1949 and took effect in 1950.
en.n: The Constituent Assembly first met on December 9, 1946; the constitution was completed later.

zh.t: 印度制宪会议首次召开
zh.s: 1946年12月9日，印度制宪会议在新德里的宪法大厅举行第一次会议，上午11时开会，由萨钦德拉纳特·辛哈暂任主席。这是后来起草印度宪法的机构的首次会议；宪法直到1949年才通过，并于1950年生效。
zh.n: 制宪会议于1946年12月9日首次开会；宪法是在此后完成的。

en.s: Western Tai'an Campaign was a series of battles fought between the nationalists and the communists during Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era, and resulted in the communist victory. The communists also refer this campaign as Campaign to Move Eastward (Chinese: 东进战役), and viewed this campaign as the prelude to Huaihai Campaign.

en.s: The Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (CPPCG), or the Genocide Convention, is an international treaty that criminalizes genocide and obligates state parties to pursue the enforcement of its prohibition. It was the first legal instrument to codify genocide as a crime and the first human rights treaty unanimously adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 9 December 1948, during the third session of the United Nations General Assembly.

zh.t: 《防止及惩治灭绝种族罪公约》
zh.s: 《防止及惩治灭绝种族罪公约》（CPPCG），又称《灭绝种族罪公约》，是一项将灭绝种族罪定为刑事犯罪，并要求缔约国执行禁令的国际条约。它是首个将灭绝种族罪编入成文法的法律文书，也是联合国大会于1948年12月9日在第三届会议上一致通过的首项人权条约。

en.s: Trans-Canada Air Lines Flight 810-9 was a Canadair North Star on a scheduled flight from Vancouver to Calgary (continuing to Regina, Winnipeg, and Toronto). The plane crashed into Mount Slesse near Chilliwack, British Columbia, Canada, on 9 December 1956 after encountering severe icing and turbulence over the mountains. All 62 people on board died, making it one of the deadliest airline crashes ever as of that date; it still ranks as the sixth deadliest air disaster in Canadian history.

zh.t: 加拿大跨大陆航空810-9号班机空难
zh.s: 加拿大跨大陆航空810-9号班机由一架加拿大航空北极星客机执飞，原定从温哥华飞往卡尔加里，随后继续前往里贾纳、温尼伯和多伦多。1956年12月9日，飞机在遭遇山区严重结冰和乱流后，于不列颠哥伦比亚省奇利瓦克附近撞上斯莱斯山。机上62人全部遇难。截至当时，这是史上最严重的航空事故之一；如今它仍是加拿大死亡人数第六多的空难。

en.s: The 1956 Cupa României final was the 19th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Energia Câmpia Turzii and Progresul Oradea, and was won by Progresul Oradea after a game with 2 goals. It was the first cup for Progresul Oradea. Energia Câmpia Turzii was the fifth club representing Divizia B which reached the Romanian Cup final.

en.s: The Lisunov Li-2 (NATO reporting name: Cab), originally designated PS-84, is a license-built Soviet version of the Douglas DC-3. zh.t: 一架俄罗斯航空李-2客机在阿纳德尔附近坠毁，机上12人全部遇难
zh.s: 李-2型飞机（北约代号：Cab），最初编号为PS-84，是苏联依据许可证生产的道格拉斯DC-3型飞机。它最初由莫斯科希姆基的第84国营飞机厂生产；1941年该厂撤迁后，生产转至塔什干航空生产联合体。该项目由航空工程师鲍里斯·帕夫洛维奇·利苏诺夫负责。

en.s: Coronation Street (informally known as Corrie) is a British soap opera created by Granada Television and shown on ITV since 9 December 1960. The programme centres on Coronation Street in Weatherfield, a fictional town based on Salford, its terraced houses, café, corner shop, newsagents, textile factory and The Rovers Return pub. In the show's fictional history, the street was built in the early 1900s and named in honour of the coronation of King Edward VII. The show typically airs five times a week; Monday and Friday 7.30–8pm & 8.30–9pm and Wednesday 7.30–8pm, however this occasionally varies due to sport or around Christmas and New Year.

zh.s: 《加冕街》（昵称“Corrie”）是英国肥皂剧，由格拉纳达电视台制作，自1960年12月9日起在ITV播出。故事围绕虚构小镇韦瑟菲尔德的加冕街展开；小镇以索尔福德为蓝本，街上有排屋、咖啡馆、街角商店、报刊亭、纺织厂和“流浪者归来”酒吧。剧中设定这条街建于20世纪初，名字是为纪念爱德华七世加冕。节目通常每周播出五次：周一和周五晚上7时30分至8时、8时30分至9时，周三晚上7时30分至8时；体育赛事、圣诞节和新年期间偶尔会调整。

en.s: Operation Python, a follow-up to Operation Trident, was a code name of a naval attack launched on West Pakistan's port city of Karachi by the Indian Navy during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971. en.s: The 1975 mayoral election was held to select the 37th mayor of San Francisco, and was held in two parts. en.s: The 1984 Intercontinental Cup was an association football match between Liverpool F.C. of England and Club Atlético Independiente of Argentina on 9 December 1984 at the National Stadium in Tokyo, Japan, the annual Intercontinental Cup contested between the winners of the Copa Libertadores and European Cup. en.s: The First Intifada (Arabic: الانتفاضة الأولى, romanized: al-Intifāḍa al-’Ūlā, lit. 'The First Uprising'), also known as the First Palestinian Intifada, was a sustained uprising involving violent and non-violent protests, acts of civil disobedience, riots, and terrorist attacks carried out by Palestinian civilians and militants in the Israeli-occupied Palestinian territories and Israel. It was motivated by collective Palestinian frustration over Israel's military occupation of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip as it approached a twenty-year mark, having begun in the wake of the 1967 Arab–Israeli War. The uprising lasted from December 1987 until the Madrid Conference of 1991, though some date its conclusion to 1993, the year the Oslo Accords were signed. The Intifada began on 9 December 1987 in the Jabalia refugee camp after an Israeli truck driver collided with parked civilian vehicles, killing four Palestinian workers, three of whom were from the refugee camp.

zh.t: 第一次巴勒斯坦大起义
zh.s: 第一次大起义（阿拉伯语：الانتفاضة الأولى，音译：al-Intifāḍa al-’Ūlā，意为“第一次起义”），也称第一次巴勒斯坦大起义，是巴勒斯坦平民和武装人员在以色列占领的巴勒斯坦领土及以色列境内持续发起的一场起义，期间既有暴力和非暴力抗议、公民不服从行动和骚乱，也有恐怖袭击。以色列自1967年阿以战争后对约旦河西岸和加沙地带实施军事占领，临近二十年时，巴勒斯坦人普遍对此感到不满，这成为起义的动因。起义从1987年12月持续至1991年马德里会议；也有人将其结束时间定为1993年，即《奥斯陆协议》签署之年。1987年12月9日，贾巴利亚难民营发生起义导火事件：一名以色列卡车司机撞上停放的民用车辆，造成四名巴勒斯坦工人死亡，其中三人来自该难民营。

en.s: The 2020 Makassar mayoral election was held on 9 December 2020, as part of the 2020 simultaneous local elections in Indonesia. The 2020 election saw the previous incumbent mayor, Mohammad Ramdhan Pomanto, the 2018 single candidate Munafri Arifuddin, run as mayor along with former deputy mayor Syamsu Rizal and former East Luwu regent Irman Yasin Limpo.

zh.s: 望加锡于2020年12月9日举行市长选举，是印度尼西亚2020年同步地方选举的一部分。这是2018年选举后的重选：当时只有一名候选人参选，选票中的“以上皆非”选项获得多数。2020年，前任市长穆罕默德·拉姆丹·波曼托参选；2018年的唯一候选人穆纳夫里·阿里夫丁、前副市长沙姆苏·里扎尔和东卢武县前县长伊尔曼·亚辛·林波也都参选。

en.s: The 2020 Surakarta mayoral election was held on 9 December 2020, as part of the 2020 simultaneous local elections across Indonesia. The mayoral seat was contested between Gibran Rakabuming Raka and independent candidate Bagyo Wahyono.

zh.s: 梭罗市于2020年12月9日举行市长选举，是印度尼西亚2020年同步地方选举的一部分。候选人为吉布兰·拉卡布明·拉卡和独立候选人巴吉奥·瓦希约诺。

en.s: The 2020 South Tangerang mayoral election was held on 9 December 2020 to elect the mayor of South Tangerang as part of the 2020 Indonesian local elections. The incumbent mayor, Airin Rachmi Diany, was term-limited and couldn't run for re-election. The sitting vice-mayor, Benyamin Davnie of Golkar, was elected in her stead, winning more than 40% of the vote.

zh.s: 南唐格朗于2020年12月9日举行市长选举，是印度尼西亚2020年地方选举的一部分。时任市长艾琳·拉赫米·迪亚妮因任期限制不能竞选连任。戈尔卡尔党候选人、时任副市长贝尼亚明·达夫尼当选，得票率超过40%。

en.s: Local elections (Indonesian: Pemilihan Kepala Daerah, Pilkada) were held in Indonesia on 9 December 2020. Voters elected nine governors, 224 regents, and 37 mayors across the country. All the elections were held on the same day, and over 100 million people were expected to be eligible to vote.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于2020年12月9日举行地方选举（印度尼西亚语：Pemilihan Kepala Daerah，简称Pilkada）。全国选出9名省长、224名县长和37名市长，所有选举都在同一天举行。当时预计有超过1亿人具备投票资格。

en.s: The 2020 North Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 9 December 2020 to elect both the governor and vice-governor of North Sulawesi as part of local elections across Indonesia. The incumbent governor, Olly Dondokambey, won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 北苏拉威西省长选举于2020年12月9日举行，是印度尼西亚地方选举的一部分，选出省长和副省长。时任省长奥利·东多坎贝连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Lusail (Arabic: معركة لوسيل, Spanish: Batalla de Lusail, Dutch: De slag van Lusail) is the nickname of a football match played in the quarter-finals of the 2022 FIFA World Cup between the Netherlands and Argentina at the Lusail Stadium in Lusail, Qatar on 9 December 2022. Spanish referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz issued a FIFA World Cup record 18 yellow cards and one red card, setting a new record for cautions at any FIFA-administered international tournament.

zh.s: “卢赛尔之战”是对2022年12月9日在卡塔尔卢赛尔体育场举行的一场2022年世界杯四分之一决赛的称呼，对阵双方是荷兰和阿根廷。西班牙籍主裁判安东尼奥·马特乌·拉奥斯出示18张黄牌和1张红牌，黄牌数创下世界杯纪录，也刷新了国际足联主办的国际赛事警告次数纪录。

en.s: The Yangtse clash of 9 December 2022 occurred at night between the troops of the Indian Army and the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) along their mutually contested Line of Actual Control (LAC) in the Yangtse region of Tawang district in Arunachal Pradesh. Violent clashes ensued after the two armies confronted each other with nail-studded clubs and other melee weapons near positions on a border ridgeline in close vicinity of the revered Buddhist site of Chumi Gyatse Falls.

zh.s: 2022年12月9日夜间，印度陆军与中国人民解放军在阿鲁纳恰尔邦达旺县扬策地区的实际控制线附近发生冲突。双方在边境山脊附近的阵地对峙，随后使用钉有铁钉的棍棒等近身武器激烈交战。交战地点靠近受尊崇的佛教圣地楚米嘉策瀑布。

en.s: The 2023 Final Resolution was the professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on December 9, 2023, at the Don Kolov Arena in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada and aired on Impact Plus. It was the 12th event under the Final Resolution chronology, the first to be held since the 2020 event. Twelve matches were contested at the event, including three on the pre-show.

zh.s: 2023年终极决战大赛是由Impact摔角联盟制作的职业摔角赛事，于2023年12月9日在加拿大安大略省米西索加的唐·科洛夫竞技场举行，并通过Impact Plus播出。这是终极决战系列第12届赛事，也是2020年之后首次举办。当天共进行了12场比赛，其中3场在预热赛中举行。

en.s: The 2023 Emperor's Cup final was an association football match between Kawasaki Frontale and Kashiwa Reysol on 9 December 2023 at Japan National Stadium in Tokyo. It was the 103rd edition of the Emperor's Cup, organised by the Japan Football Association (JFA). Kawasaki Frontale were playing in their third Emperor's Cup final, following being champions in 2020 and runners-up in 2016.

zh.s: 2023年日本天皇杯决赛于2023年12月9日在东京的日本国立竞技场举行，由川崎前锋对阵柏太阳神。这是由日本足球协会主办的第103届天皇杯决赛。川崎前锋第三次闯入决赛，此前曾在2020年夺冠、2016年获得亚军。

en.s: The 2023 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2023 Norwegian Football Cup, the 117th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 9 December 2023 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo between two Eliteserien sides, Bodø/Glimt and Molde.

zh.s: 2023年挪威足球杯决赛是该赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是挪威足协主办的挪威最高级别杯赛第117个赛季的决赛。比赛于2023年12月9日在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔体育场举行，对阵双方是博德闪耀和莫尔德，两队都参加挪威足球超级联赛。

en.t: Kaya–Iloilo wins the Copa Paulino Alcantara final on penalties
en.s: Kaya–Iloilo beat Davao Aguilas in the Copa Paulino Alcantara final at Rizal Memorial Stadium in Manila on December 9, 2023. The teams were tied 1–1 after extra time, and Kaya won the penalty shootout 4–3. This was the club’s third cup title in the competition.
en.n: The final was played on December 9, 2023; the 4–3 score is the penalty shootout.

zh.t: 卡亚伊洛伊洛点球取胜，夺得保利诺·阿尔坎塔拉杯
zh.s: 2023年12月9日，卡亚伊洛伊洛与达沃阿吉拉斯在马尼拉黎刹纪念体育场争夺保利诺·阿尔坎塔拉杯冠军。加时赛后双方仍以1比1战平，卡亚伊洛伊洛在点球大战中以4比3获胜，第三次夺得这项杯赛冠军。
zh.n: 决赛在当天举行；4比3是点球大战比分。

en.s: ONE Fight Night 17: Kryklia vs. Roberts was a Muay Thai event produced by ONE Championship that took place on December 9, 2023, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand. It marked the first event that was only a Muay Thai card.

en.s: The 2023 Houston mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, with a runoff on December 9 because no candidate won a majority of the vote in the first round. It was held to elect the mayor of Houston, Texas. Incumbent Democratic mayor Sylvester Turner was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office. Municipal elections in Texas are officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 2023年美国职业足球大联盟杯决赛是该赛事第28届，于2023年12月9日在美国俄亥俄州哥伦布的Lower.com球场举行，决出当赛季冠军。主队哥伦布机员来自东部联盟，挑战者洛杉矶FC是卫冕冠军，来自西部联盟。

en.s: By-elections were held in Zimbabwe on 11 November 2023, on 9 December 2023, on 3 February 2024 and on 27 April 2024 to fill vacancies in the National Assembly and in local government. The by-elections were triggered by Sengezo Tshabangu, who claimed to be the interim Secretary-General of the Citizens Coalition for Change, when he recalled nine constituency legislators, six proportional representative women’s quota and senators and seventeen councilors mainly from Bulawayo, one of the party's strongholds.

zh.s: 津巴布韦于2023年11月11日、12月9日、2024年2月3日和4月27日举行补选，填补国民议会及地方政府的空缺。变革公民联盟秘书长塞恩杰佐·查班古声称自己是该党的临时秘书长，并召回了9名选区议员、6名妇女配额比例代表议员和参议员，以及17名地方议员，主要来自该党据点之一布拉瓦约。这些召回行动引发了补选。

en.t: 2024 NCAA Division I women's soccer championship game
en.s: The 2024 NCAA Division I women's soccer championship game (also known as the 2024 NCAA Division I Women's College Cup) was played on December 9, 2024, at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary, North Carolina, and determined the winner of the 2024 NCAA Division I women's soccer tournament, the national collegiate women's soccer championship in the United States. This was the 43rd edition of this tournament organized by the NCAA.

zh.t: 2024年NCAA第一级女子足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年NCAA第一级女子足球锦标赛决赛，也称2024年NCAA女子大学杯，于2024年12月9日在北卡罗来纳州卡里的维克梅德足球公园举行，决出2024年NCAA女子足球锦标赛冠军，也就是美国大学女子足球全国冠军。这是NCAA主办的第43届该项赛事。
